# SPEC-NNN Conformance Report

> This report records evidence. A complete report does not itself authorize
> the governing Specification's `implemented` transition.

## Review Scope

Link the exact approved Specification revision, implementation plan, relevant
design notes, code revision, and environments reviewed.

## Acceptance-Criterion Results

| Criterion | Result | Evidence | Notes / exception authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AC-1` or exact criterion text | pass / fail / blocked / approved exception | Stable evidence link | Explanation |

Every acceptance criterion must appear exactly once.

## Required-Test Results

Record commands or procedures, environments, dates, outcomes, and stable logs
or reports. Do not substitute build success for behavioral evidence.

## Profile, Backend, and Platform Evidence

Separate dynamic/static, backend, host, simulator, hardware-free, and
connected-hardware results. Name exact target configurations.

## Resource and Performance Evidence

Record measurement conditions, budgets, results, and reproducibility details.

## Deviations and Exceptions

List every implementation divergence, failed requirement, missing evidence,
and explicitly approved exception. Code divergence does not amend the
Specification.

## Deferred Work Audit

List discoveries captured outside current scope and confirm that none is
required for current conformance.

## Review Conclusion

State whether every criterion has sufficient evidence, which gates remain
open, and whether the report supports requesting the human `implemented`
transition. Do not perform that transition in this report.
